title: Security: Dual Authorization and Transaction Controls
summary: This document explains dual authorization and transaction controls: dual authorization is required for transactions above $10,000, with initiation/review/approval roles configured so no one person can create and release a high-value transaction. It also covers applying dual authorization to wires and high-value ACH, enabling real-time balance validation (set to Yes) to prevent insufficient-funds releases, and monitoring/testing via approval logs and simulated >$10,000 requests.
faqs: When is dual authorization required (what transaction threshold)?
How should we configure initiation, review, and approval roles to prevent one-person release?
Which payment types should have dual authorization applied (e.g., wires or high-value ACH)?
How does enabling real-time balance information help approvers avoid insufficient funds?
What logs and periodic tests should we review to confirm approval gates are working?
How can we validate controls by testing with transactions above the threshold?
keywords: Control testing via simulated requests above $10,000
